NyatrimDesc1: Sekale is an impressive display of the usage of Azhi in construction
NyatrimDesc2: Shenegrîr is incredibly tall with an impressive landscape
NyatrimDesc3: The people of Shenegrîr have an extremely multicultural background, despite geographic isolation
NyatrimDesc4: Almost an analogy to the height of the Shenegrîr plateau, many nickname the region 'the paradise'
NyMkWar1: The first war was fought at a time of great urgency and vulnerability for the fledgling Nyatrim Order
NyMkWar2: The First Arbiter had already predicted the war and prepared accordingly, in fact he trained hundreds of Dlaebans for it
NyMkWar3: The Second Arbiter during this warring period was in fact only a child, carefully trained by higher-ups of the order
NyMkWar4: Imkîrerun commanders faced one major challenge: there existed only one easy passage between the Daban desert and the Shenegrîr heartland, through the source of the Agāsarra
NuRaid1: During the reign of the Nineteenth Gelârm Kehbiegg Ynuserme, the tribes of Nrayephet united under a strong Pentarch
NuRaid2: Tens of thousands of horsemen departed from isolated Nrayephet, easily wreaking havoc in Shey and Mikarrun green lands
NuRaid3: The Nrayepheti horde ransacked important trading hubs such as Dâziy and nearly took Tabahshaf, but were stopped at Luysebedir (451 AW)
NuRaid4: For years prior to the raids, Nrayephetis from all levels of society wished to break free from the vassalage imposed upon them by the Empire.
WaywDesc1: Despair is like the story of the wayward traveler, which ended his sight after having been blindsided by the murky and gloomy veil of a moonless night...
WaywDesc2: Is dirt that all have so obliviously hammered down ever needy of explanations?...
WaywDesc3: They are a major piece of oral literature from the Sakh-har Daban (Desert of Daban) and they include many short stories with great insight
WaywDesc4: And in an unending motion, beat the desert’s hoarfrost...
FederCr1: The Federation was created soon after the Oblivion Coup in 1592 AW when southern fringe states sought independence from the Empire
FederCr2: The Federation still stands strong in 1750 AW, even 150 years after its creation
FederCr3: Sanmeca greatly influenced others in the south to follow suit after they declared independence and soon they all allied against a common enemy
FederCr4: Egyî'an is one of the youngest Tegdenem (kingdom) in Khaiyuh'a and traces its origins to the time of the Federation.
